output.answer: Roblox's CEO is David Baszucki, who is also the company's founder. He remains Chief Executive Officer as of November 2026 — Roblox's own leadership page lists him as 'Founder and Chief Executive Officer,' and a Roblox newsroom post published November 9, 2026 describes 'Roblox Founder and CEO David Baszucki.' He co-founded Roblox (originally Knowledge Revolution, later Roblox Corporation) and has led it since its founding.
caveats: The Roblox leadership page carries no explicit 'last updated' date, but it was retrieved on 2026-11-11 and the November 9, 2026 newsroom post independently confirms Baszucki was still CEO days before today.
